sql-set.sql: SELECT "Id", "PolicyNumber", "PolicyName", "LineOfBusinessCode", "PolicyType", "StatusCode", "TransactionType", "QuoteId", "RenewalStatus", "InsuredId", "InsuredName", "InsuredAddress", "EffectiveDate", "ExpirationDate", "OriginalEffectiveDate", "AccountingDate", "CancellationDate", "CancelReasonDescription", "TotalPremium", "SumInsured", "Deductible", "Currency", "ProducerCode", "ProducerName", "UnderwriterId", "UnderwriterName", "AgentCode", "VesselName", "VesselType", "CargoType", "RouteFrom", "RouteTo", "AircraftRegistration", "FlightNumber", "RiskDescription", "SurveyorName", "Remarks", "CreatedBy", "CreatedDateTime", "UpdatedBy", "UpdatedDateTime", "CustomFields" AS "CustomFieldJson" FROM "McaPolicy" WHERE "Id" = @Id AND "IsDeleted" = false;

SELECT "Id", "PolicyNumber", "PolicyName", "LineOfBusinessCode", "PolicyType", "StatusCode", "TransactionType", "QuoteId", "RenewalStatus", "InsuredId", "InsuredName", "InsuredAddress", "EffectiveDate", "ExpirationDate", "OriginalEffectiveDate", "AccountingDate", "CancellationDate", "CancelReasonDescription", "TotalPremium", "SumInsured", "Deductible", "Currency", "ProducerCode", "ProducerName", "UnderwriterId", "UnderwriterName", "AgentCode", "VesselName", "VesselType", "CargoType", "RouteFrom", "RouteTo", "AircraftRegistration", "FlightNumber", "RiskDescription", "SurveyorName", "Remarks", "CreatedBy", "CreatedDateTime", "UpdatedBy", "UpdatedDateTime", "CustomFields" AS "CustomFieldJson" FROM "McaPolicy" WHERE "IsDeleted" = false ORDER BY "UpdatedDateTime" DESC;
SELECT "PolicyNumber" FROM "McaPolicy" ORDER BY "CreatedDateTime" DESC LIMIT 1;
